title: lilac × persica var. dubia
intro: Lilac × persica var. dubia, commonly known as Syringa persica 'Dubia' or Persian lilac, is a hybrid plant species within the lilac family, known for its unique characteristics and fragrant flowers. This plant is said to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lilac × persica var. dubia include promoting relaxation and reducing stress due to its calming scent, as well as its ability to ease anxiety and improve mood. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
